verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document C2PA content credentials or any provenance or AI-disclosure watermark on generated output. The only watermark mentioned is a free-tier plan limitation ('3 videos a month, watermarked'). That is a pricing-tier restriction, not a documented provenance signal, so it counts as an adjacent feature. A community commenter also noted having no easy way to verify a HeyGen-dubbed video, which is consistent with no surfaced provenance mechanism.

support.subject: As a marketer, generated output carries documented provenance signals (C2PA metadata or a disclosed watermark) I can point to
